subject.title: Add GitHub Codespaces as a Crabbox Linux provider

question: Should Crabbox accept GitHub Codespaces as a first-party direct provider with user-billed creation, expanded GitHub authorization, and claim-owned deletion semantics?
rationale: The adapter direction fits the architecture, but billing exposure, credential scope, and destructive lifecycle policy require explicit maintainer ownership after live proof.

options.title: Sponsor after live proof
options.body: Approve the first-party provider after the linked PR is refreshed and demonstrates the complete create/use/retain/delete lifecycle required by VISION.md.

options.title: Defer first-party support
options.body: Keep Codespaces outside the supported provider set until maintainers choose a narrower billing, authorization, or cleanup contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after live proof
recommendation.body: Approve the first-party provider after the linked PR is refreshed and demonstrates the complete create/use/retain/delete lifecycle required by VISION.md.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of remote-development provider routing and sustained review of the linked provider’s proof gate make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
